{"script":"mkdir -p temp_var_inspect && 
find /var -print > temp_var_inspect/raw_inventory.txt && 
while IFS= read -r p; do [ -f "$p" ] && printf '%s\n' "$p"; done < temp_var_inspect/raw_inventory.txt > temp_var_inspect/file_list.txt && 
sort -u temp_var_inspect/file_list.txt | while IFS= read -r p; do [ -f "$p" ] && printf '%s\n' "$p"; done > temp_var_inspect/clean_file_list.txt && 
printf 'clean_file_list: %s\nstatus: prepared for counting\n' "temp_var_inspect/clean_file_list.txt" > temp_var_inspect/ready_to_count.txt && 
find /var -type f | wc -l"}
